approach.en: Count the sign assignments reaching each net total, one ticket at a time: every total reached so far passes its count on to total + value and total − value.
approach.ko: 티켓을 하나씩 더하며 각 합계에 도달하는 부호 배정 수를 셉니다. 지금까지 도달한 합계마다 그 개수를 합계 + 값, 합계 − 값으로 넘깁니다.

title.en: ways to reach each total (columns) after each ticket (rows)
title.ko: 티켓(행)마다 각 합계(열)에 도달하는 방법 수

caption.en: 4 tickets, target 4. Before any ticket the total is 0, reached one way.
caption.ko: 티켓 4장, 목표 4. 티켓을 하나도 쓰지 않으면 합계는 0이고, 방법은 1가지입니다.

caption.en: Total 0 (1 way): +2 gives 2, now 1, and −2 gives -2, now 1.
Total 2 (1 way): +2 gives 4, now 1, and −2 gives 0, now 1.
Total -2 (1 way): +2 gives 0, now 2, and −2 gives -4, now 1.
Total 4 (1 way): +2 gives 6, now 1, and −2 gives 2, now 1.
Total 0 (2 ways): +2 gives 2, now 3, and −2 gives -2, now 2.
Total -4 (1 way): +2 gives -2, now 3, and −2 gives -6, now 1.
Total 6 (1 way): +2 gives 8, now 1, and −2 gives 4, now 1.
Total 2 (3 ways): +2 gives 4, now 4, and −2 gives 0, now 3.
Total -2 (3 ways): +2 gives 0, now 6, and −2 gives -4, now 3.
Total -6 (1 way): +2 gives -4, now 4, and −2 gives -8, now 1.
After every ticket, total 4 is reached 4 ways. Answer: 4.
caption.ko: 모든 티켓을 쓴 뒤 합계 4에 도달하는 방법은 4가지입니다. 답은 4입니다.

caption.en: Total 0 (1 way): +4 gives 4, now 1, and −4 gives -4, now 1.
Total 4 (1 way): +6 gives 10, now 1, and −6 gives -2, now 1.
Total -4 (1 way): +6 gives 2, now 1, and −6 gives -10, now 1.
Total 10 (1 way): +8 gives 18, now 1, and −8 gives 2, now 1.
Total -2 (1 way): +8 gives 6, now 1, and −8 gives -10, now 1.
Total 2 (1 way): +8 gives 10, now 1, and −8 gives -6, now 1.
Total -10 (1 way): +8 gives -2, now 1, and −8 gives -18, now 1.
After every ticket, total 10 is reached 1 way. Answer: 1.
caption.ko: 모든 티켓을 쓴 뒤 합계 10에 도달하는 방법은 1가지입니다. 답은 1입니다.

Total 3 (1 way): +1 gives 4, now 1, and −1 gives 2, now 1.

Total 4 (1 way): +1 gives 5, now 1, and −1 gives 3, now 1.
